mapper.select: select id as categoryId, name as categoryName, sort_no as sortOrder, active as isActive from category where active = true order by sort_no asc
SELECT id AS menuId, cat_id AS categoryId, name, price, image_url AS imageUrl, sold_out AS isSoldOut FROM menu ORDER BY cat_id ASC, id ASC
select id as menuId, cat_id as categoryId, name, price, image_url as imageUrl, sold_out as isSoldOut from menu where id = #{ menuId }
